name: claude-quickstarts
description: A collection of projects designed to help developers quickly get started with building deployable applications using the Claude API
one_liner: A set of ready-made example apps (a support bot, a finance chat tool, browsing agents) that show step by step how to build a real product on top of Claude.
buyer: A freelance developer or small agency that wants to pitch and deliver a working Claude-powered app for a client fast, without starting from a blank page.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer forks the customer-support-agent quickstart to ship a branded support bot for a small e-commerce client in days instead of weeks.
An agency uses the financial-data-analyst quickstart as the base for a paid 'chat with your numbers' tool sold to bookkeeping and accounting clients.
A course creator runs a paid weekend workshop teaching non-developers to launch one of these quickstarts as their first AI product.

money_ideas.idea: Rapid client-build service: a working Claude app in a week, scaffolded from these quickstarts
Paid cohort-based workshop teaching people to launch one of these quickstarts

steal_this: Take the customer-support-agent quickstart, swap in a real client's FAQ knowledge base, and have a working demo ready to sell by Monday.
